description: A Minecraft Fabric mod for Hypixel Skyblock

releases.notes:
### Fixes:
- Fixed puzzle checkmark on the map not updating when a puzzle resets
- Fixed various unintended passive FPS drops
- Fixed Hide Explosions hiding particles when it shouldn't
- Fixed Special Column's client-side room discovery causing uncertain rooms to appear as discovered
- Fixed various edge cases where Etherwarp estimates were incorrect
- Fixed Fire Freeze Timer after the mayor update

### Improvements:
- Slightly improved API lookup times by using a faster UUID endpoint
- Made Blaze Solver scan blazes instantly on spawn, significantly improving scan speed
- Changed Gyro Wand cooldown detection to use particles instead of the action bar message, which is no longer sent

### Additions:
- Added an option to hide blazes in Blaze Solver
- Added a command to force-enable or disable Paul (`/od paul on`)
- Added options to adjust head, background, and pointer scales in the Dungeon Map

Full Changelog: https://github.com/odtheking/Odin/compare/0.3.6...0.4.0

Dependencies are:
Fabric API
Fabric Language Kotlin

## Fixes

- Fixed beacon rendering having an invalid texture
- Fixed beacon rendering not rotating
- Fixed Dragon Ice Spray timer always showing 0
- Fixed TerminalSounds not working
- Fixed TerminalTimes showing incorrect end-of-phase timings
- Fixed Auto Kick getting the incorrect floor
- Fixed self marker in Dungeon Map not rotating correctly
- Fixed WebSocket allowing all players in the same lobby to share data
- Fixed Invincibility Timer not showing in the HUD Manager with some settings
- Fixed Livid invulnerability timer (alpha)
- Fixed Numbers Sim showing 14 numbers (alpha)
- Fixed Numbers Term GUI showing 14 numbers (alpha)
- Fixed Melody TermSim showing 4 rows (alpha)
- Fixed Melody Solver being based on 4 rows (alpha)
- Fixed Melody message being based on 4 rows (alpha)
- Fixed Simon Says Solver being based on 5 buttons (alpha)
- Fixed Watcher kill time being incorrect (alpha)
- Fixed Watcher bar health being incorrect (alpha)
- Fixed Splits ending with the Necron death message (alpha)
- Fixed Goldor start, Storm lightning, Storm phase, and Storm tick having incorrect timings (alpha)

## Improvements

- Various improvements to the ClickGUI, including a redesigned ColorSetting for better space utilization and a favorite colors system
- Redesigned the DWP GUI for easier and more intuitive pack management
- Renamed Waypoints module to Temporary Waypoints
- Simplified settings in InactiveWaypoints and improved waypoint handling
- Made InactiveWaypoints show the terminal's actual hitbox and renamed the module to Terminal Status
- Removed Dragon Priority and changed it to prioritize dragons by spawn order (alpha)
- Improved Spring Boots precision

## Additions

- Added a new Waypoints module allowing you to create waypoints at specific areas/phases of the game, with proximity, visual, and click-trigger methods for commands, customizable rendering, and a simple GUI. Use `/odwaypoints` to configure it. Replaces the Positional Message module
- Added Fire Freeze Timer
- Added `/od toggle` command for toggling modules
- Added support for multiple bat kills

Full Changelog: https://github.com/odtheking/Odin/compare/0.3.3...0.3.6

Dependencies are:
Fabric API
Fabric Language Kotlin

## Fixes:

* Fixed Vesuvius not working sometimes
* Fixed Invincibility Timer having incorrect timings for certain items
* Fixed Secrets HUD showing when a room has a maximum of 0 secrets
* Fixed update message formatting
* Fixed Boss Entry split being positioned incorrectly
* Fixed Simon Says checking any block for its power state

## Improvements:

* Improved range check for skull click detection
* Reorganized Invincibility Timer settings for clarity
* Made Dungeon Waypoints render underneath things like Clicked Secret or Etherwarp
* Improved WebSocket handling in certain edge cases
* Made AABBs rotate according to room rotation

## Additions:

* Added Quiver Display
* Added Kuudra Tracker
* Added support for coop chat in Chat Commands

## Fixes

* Fixed Croesus not correctly highlighting chest state + added Kismet state
* Fixed Bonzo Mask timer not correctly using your current cooldown reduction

## Improvements

* Made `/dwp import` support a JSON/compressed string or URL of valid dungeon waypoints for easier distribution
* Removed the out-of-bounds tick timer, as the tech it was useful for is no longer possible
* Made puzzle timer have puzzle-dependent minimum times

* Added room secret support to Dungeon Map
* Added WebSocket support for Dungeon Map
* Added an option to show player name / player class name in Melody Progress GUI
* Added Storm tick timer (tick timer starting when Storm starts until he ends)
* Readded dragon titles to the WitherDragons module
* Added support for Kuudra pet bonus and Lava Leech bonus in Vesuvius
* Added an option to toggle showing 0-time splits
